title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant Spider is advertising on behalf of Ellisons, who are looking for a creative, organised and enthusiastic Marketing Assistant to join their growing marketing team in Colchester, Essex. This is a permanent opportunity to gain hands-on experience across digital marketing, events, content creation and business development support, with excellent opportunities to develop your career.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Salary: Competitive + discretionary performance bonus
- Benefits: Generous leave entitlement, enhanced family policies, mental health and wellbeing support, and professional development

About the role

You'll join an established team of five, supporting marketing campaigns, digital communications and events across the firm. With plenty of variety and opportunities to contribute ideas, you'll help bring marketing initiatives to life.

Key responsibilities include:
- Supporting marketing campaigns, promotional materials and internal communications
- Coordinating seminars, networking events, sponsorships and exhibitions
- Creating and scheduling social media posts, graphics and short-form videos
- Updating website content and working with external digital agencies
- Producing newsletters, marketing collateral and email campaigns
- Liaising with suppliers and supporting advertising activities
- Maintaining marketing records, content calendars and performance reports

About you

You'll have previous experience in marketing, communications, events or administration, with strong organisational skills, creativity and excellent attention to detail.

You'll be a confident communicator, comfortable managing deadlines and working with colleagues, stakeholders and suppliers.

Experience using Canva, Microsoft Office and social media platforms is essential, alongside an understanding of digital marketing.

Experience with website content management systems, video editing, email marketing, SEO or analytics would be advantageous. A marketing qualification and experience within professional services, particularly the legal sector, would also be beneficial.

Most importantly, you'll be proactive, enthusiastic and keen to learn, with the ambition to develop a long-term career in marketing.

About Ellisons

Ellisons is an established regional law firm with a strong presence across East Anglia. You'll join a collaborative team offering mentorship, professional development and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as your skills grow.

To be considered, apply through Spider with an up-to-date CV.

Spider is committed to equal opportunities and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates. Please advise us of any reasonable adjustments required during recruitment. Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for correspondence.

Spider is advertising this vacancy on behalf of the employer. Your details will be processed for this vacancy, and you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Full Privacy Policy details will be provided by email upon application.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Grays - Thurrock - Essex (Due to location this role is best suited to someone with access to a vehicle)

Salary: Permanent - Competitive 38,000 - 40,000

A dynamic and innovative organisation within the building and construction sector is seeking a passionate Marketing Executive to elevate its brand and drive strategic marketing initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact within a thriving industry, where creativity meets construction.

About the Role

As a Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering the company's marketing strategy. This is a varied position with responsibilities including:
- Developing and implementing effective marketing campaigns to promote products and services.
- Conducting market research to identify new opportunities and emerging industry trends.
- Collaborating with internal teams to create engaging content that resonates with target audiences.
- Managing social media channels and digital marketing activities to enhance online visibility and engagement.
- Monitoring and analysing campaign performance to optimise results and maximise ROI.
- Assisting with the planning and delivery of exhibitions, events and promotional activities.

Key Requirements

To be successful in this role, you should have:
- A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within the building and construction sector.
- A strong understanding of digital marketing, including SEO, PPC and social media marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling content.
- Experience using marketing platforms and tools such as Google Analytics, Mailchimp or HubSpot.
- A creative mindset with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What's on Offer

In return, you'll benefit from:
- A competitive salary package based on experience.
- Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
- A collaborative and supportive working environment that encourages innovation.
- Flexible working arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance.

Why Apply?

This is more than just a marketing role. It's an opportunity to join a forward-thinking business that is helping shape the future of the construction industry. If you're passionate about marketing, enjoy bringing ideas to life and want to contribute to a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Take the next step in your career and join a business that values creativity, innovation and ambition.

Apply now! Or contact Isabelle at Adecco Romford/Ilford on (phone number removed) for further information.

title: Marketing Executive - FTC 18 months
description:
Marketing Executive (18-month FTC - Maternity Cover)

32,000- 38,000 DOE

Halstead, Essex

Monday to Friday 37.5 hours per week

Own transport required due to location

We're recruiting a proactive Marketing Executive for an 18-month fixed-term contract providing maternity cover. This is a full-time, office-based role supporting B2 B marketing activity across a technical/building products environment. Due to the location, own transport is essential.

Key responsibilities:
- Support and deliver B2 B marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels
- Create and coordinate content for website, email marketing, social media, brochures and case studies
- Maintain and update website content using a CMS
- Produce sales support materials (presentations, datasheets, product literature)
- Support events, promotions and product/sector activity
- Liaise with external suppliers/agencies as required
- Track activity and provide marketing performance reporting (analytics/insights)

Skills & experience required:
- Previous experience in a Marketing Executive/Coordinator role (B2 B preferred)
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills
- Experience using a CMS, email platforms and basic analytics/reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics)
- Highly organised with good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines
- Own transport required (due to location)
